title: kbgit.py contribute on git older than 2.38 leaves every commit out with exit 1, where git.md says it exits 2
goal: kbgit.py contribute checks up front that git merge-tree --write-tree is available and exits 2 naming the git version when it is not, as kb/_self/git.md says

run: import re,sys; s=open('_tools/kg_contrib.py').read(); sys.exit(0 if re.search(r'--version|merge-tree.{0,40}-h|write-tree.{0,80}(exit|return) 2', s) else 1)

repro_reason: the behaviour needs a git older than 2.38, which this host does not have (git 2.50); the repro reads for an up-front version or feature check

run:
import os,shutil,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile
here=os.getcwd();T=tempfile.mkdtemp();real=shutil.which("git")
E={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(("GIT_","KB_","CLAUDE"))}
E.update(GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=os.devnull,GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM="1",GIT_AUTHOR_NAME="t",GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL="t"+chr(64)+"example.com",GIT_COMMITTER_NAME="t",GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL="t"+chr(64)+"example.com")
g=lambda *a,cwd:s.run([real,*a],cwd=cwd,env=E,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
up=os.path.join(T,"up.git");cl=os.path.join(T,"cl")
g("init","-q","--bare","-b","main",up,cwd=T);g("clone","-q",up,cl,cwd=T)
shutil.copytree(os.path.join(here,"_tools"),cl+"/_tools",ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("__pycache__","*.pyc","fixtures"))
os.makedirs(cl+"/kb/public")
open(cl+"/kb/public/_root.md","w").write("---\nroot: public\nid_prefix: S\nvisibility: public\ndescription: p\n---\n")
open(cl+"/kb/public/_sources.csv","w").write("id,url,title,publisher,licence,reuse,retrieved_utc,version_or_date,artifact_sha256,used_in,superseded_by\n")
open(cl+"/a.txt","w").write("1\n");g("add","-A",cwd=cl);g("commit","-qm","base",cwd=cl);g("push","-q","origin","HEAD:main",cwd=cl)
g("remote","add","upstream",up,cwd=cl);g("fetch","-q","upstream",cwd=cl)
open(cl+"/x.txt","w").write("2\n");g("add","-A",cwd=cl);g("commit","-qm","feat: x",cwd=cl)
sh=os.path.join(T,"bin");os.makedirs(sh)
open(sh+"/git","w").write("#!/bin/sh\nif [ \"$1\" = \"--version\" ]; then echo \"git version 2.30.0\"; exit 0; fi\nif [ \"$1\" = \"merge-tree\" ]; then echo \"usage: git merge-tree\" >&2; exit 129; fi\nexec "+real+" \"$@\"\n")
os.chmod(sh+"/git",0o755)
E2=dict(E,PATH=sh+os.pathsep+E["PATH"])
p=s.run([sys.executable,os.path.join(cl,"_tools","kbgit.py"),"contribute","--upstream","upstream"],cwd=cl,env=E2,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120)
o=p.stdout+p.stderr
print(p.returncode,o[-300:])
shutil.rmtree(T,ignore_errors=True)
sys.exit(0 if p.returncode==2 and "2.30" in o else 1)
